query: For every new incoming email in our events inbox, run an AI extraction with these variables: client_email (the external sender/client email address), event_date (latest confirmed date, YYYY-MM-DD), event_start_time (latest confirmed start time), event_summary (concise summary: event type, location, catering/food needs, AV requirements, status, special requests), and number_of_attendees (numeric only). Then add a note laying out each value: client email, event date, event start time, summary, number of attendees.

Extract two things from each new incoming email with AI: invoice_id (the invoice identifier as written; empty string if missing) and product_name (as written; empty string if missing). If either variable is present, add a note 'inv: {{invoice_id}}' / 'name: {{product_name}}' and set the status to Pending.
raw_response: {"trigger": "new_conversation_inbound", "condition_groups": [[{"property": "ai_variable", "op": "exists", "values": [], "ai_variable": {"name": "invoice_id", "type": "text", "options": []}}, {"property": "ai_variable", "op": "exists", "values": [], "ai_variable": {"name": "product_name", "type": "text", "options": []}}]], "ai_extract": {"variables": [{"name": "invoice_id", "type": "text", "description": "Invoice identifier as written in the email (subject/body/attachments). If missing, return an empty string.", "options": []}, {"name": "product_name", "type": "text", "description": "Product name as written in the email (subject/body/attachments). If missing, return an empty string.", "options": []}]}, "actions": [{"type": "add_note", "content": "inv: {{invoice_id}}\nname: {{product_name}}", "mentions": 0, "pinned": false}, {"type": "status", "status": "pending"}]}
